messages.subject: Project Juniper - board approval needed before signing
messages.plaintextBody:
Gordon, Lesley,

Before we execute, Sutherland's board should formally approve entry into the LSA and the mobilisation spend. I've drafted board minutes recording the key terms (4-year term, £420k mobilisation, ~£3.91m annual charges, 137.5%/£5.375m cap, 3.5% indexation) for your 14 May board. Let me know if you'd like any changes.

James
